### Take the Hill: How Mission Brings Men Together
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/take-the-hill
Passage: 1 Samuel 14:6-7
Points:
- Jonathan and his armor-bearer demonstrated bold faith by confronting an entire garrison, trusting that God's power to save is not limited by numbers.
- While Saul sat passively, Jonathan stepped out in courage, supported by a faithful brother willing to risk everything alongside him.
- Many believers today remain isolated in safe routines, leaving little room for shared risk and active ministry in the world.
- Christian brotherhood flourishes when believers move beyond merely discussing battles to pursuing kingdom mission together.
- Trusting Christ’s ultimate authority calls believers to unite and take ground for the gospel rather than retreat in fear.
